theorem_statement_short: On the canonical hybrid object over the audited shell, the weighted package-conditioned pressure gap is positive across audited T0 descriptor fibers and the working s-grid, so the global T0 cocycle pressure decomposes nontrivially over T1 packaging fibers and T0 is insufficient for the packaged future.

lemmas.label: packaged-future / fiber-average well-posedness
lemmas.statement_short: Audited T1 packaging fibers and their fiber-average packaged futures are well-defined over audited T0 descriptor classes on the canonical hybrid object.

lemmas.label: conditional disintegration quantity well-posedness
lemmas.statement_short: The weighted package-conditioned pressure gap is well-defined from the closed T0 pressure object and audited T1 fiber weights/profiles.

lemmas.label: non-τ-closedness / macro-admissibility obstruction lemma
lemmas.statement_short: Macro-admissibility failure on the audited shell witnesses non-τ-closedness of the T0 description relative to the packaged future object.

lemmas.label: positivity or nontriviality of the disintegration quantity
lemmas.statement_short: The weighted package-conditioned pressure gap is positive and bounded away from zero on the audited descriptor fibers and working s-grid.

lemmas.label: relation between disintegration quantity and T0 insufficiency
lemmas.statement_short: A positive weighted package-conditioned pressure gap witnesses that T0 is insufficient for the packaged future in the audited thermodynamic sense.

lemmas.label: thermodynamic consequence of strict extension
lemmas.statement_short: The strict extension from T0 to T1 has a thermodynamic consequence because the T0 pressure decomposes nontrivially over T1 packaging fibers.

lemmas.label: conditional pressure disintegration theoremlet
lemmas.statement_short: On the audited shell, the canonical hybrid object supports a nontrivial conditional pressure disintegration theoremlet: the global T0 pressure decomposes over T1 packaging fibers and T0 is not sufficient for the packaged future.

gap_status.note: The theoremlet is closed in note on the audited shell using the weighted package-conditioned pressure gap as the explicit consequence object.
